cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: Every morning, the Editor wrote the same ending. The Boss got the cake. The Dog got the dog bed. But tonight, the lights went out... and a small idea began to glow.

cues.speaker: Boss
cues.text: Well! That was not the ending I expected. Perhaps there is enough room in this story for somebody else.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: For once, the cake went to the Dog. The Boss discovered that a borrowed bed could be surprisingly comfortable. It was a small change on a small page. But somewhere, beyond the frame, the Editor paused.
